dedupe_keys.name: peepypoo and thetis jl open source hybrid modelling of water and wastewater treatment systems eawag

description: PeePyPoo (Python) and Thetis.jl (Julia) form an open-source framework for mechanistic and hybrid modelling of water and wastewater treatment systems, produced by Eawag's Process Engineering department with partners. Thetis.jl provides reactor types (continuously stirred tank and batch reactors), clarifiers and biochemical process models such as Activated Sludge Model No. 1, ozone disinfection and aeration, plus matrix-defined models read from stoichiometric tables, built on the ModelingToolkit ecosystem; PeePyPoo exposes the same functionality in Python so that mechanistic models can be combined with data-driven parts. Coverage is any treatment plant the user builds from these blocks. Both are free open-source code on GitLab with documentation and tutorials; PeePyPoo 1.0.4 is on PyPI under GPL-3.0-or-later and needs Python 3.11 or later. Caveats: it is a research framework under development, and the predefined process models are the ones listed in the documentation. Simulation uses: dynamic simulation of activated sludge and other treatment processes for plant capacity planning, control optimisation and hybrid modelling of emissions. Related records: the IWA benchmark simulation models (model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models) and QSDsan (model-qsdsan-quantitative-sustainable-design-sanitation).
